text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...Huff...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(My chest's burn'n... I can't control my breath'n.
If this keeps up, I might...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(No, I gotta keep going. The finish line...
Victory...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It's gotta be mine!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I won. I did it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I did iiiiit!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
You know, I might've been wrong about Yukino
Bijin.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
She's been running with everything she's got this
entire time. It doesn't matter that she was so
popular.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
In fact, when the boom died down, she kept
going... Her dreams kept her going!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Congrat, Yukino Bijin! You've got yourself a new
fan!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
My heart's still pounding! I can't wait to see you
run again!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: You're so cool, Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh gosh...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I think I've finally reached 'em.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I did it. I kept mov'n forward, one step at a
time. Now I just gotta keep this up...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: That was awesome, Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hishiama...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
My plan was to push everyone aside 'n seize the
top for myself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: But now I know not to underestimate you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I wanna race again! Gotta best my senior before I
take on the rest!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Did you hear that?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I know everything can't change all at once... but
now I know I'm head'n down the right path.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Now I know for sure I can capture everyone's
hearts!

text_block_list.name: TV Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Breaking news! The beautiful Umamusume model, Gold
City...

text_block_list.name: TV Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Has announced she'll be running in the next Japan
Cup!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! City's runn'n?!

text_block_list.name: TV Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Gold City has been taking time off of racing to
focus on her modeling career. There were even
rumors that she might never return to the track.

text_block_list.name: TV Announcer
text_block_list.text:
What could be behind her sudden decision to
return? Let's watch a brief snippet of her recent
press conference.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It was always my intention to return to racing.
I've kept up with my training regimen this whole
time.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
But I only recently felt that the time is finally
right for me to come back.

text_block_list.name: Entrevistador
text_block_list.text:
What makes now the right time? Was there some type
of mental switch that triggered this realization?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Something like that.

text_block_list.name: Entrevistador
text_block_list.text:
Is there a particular reason you've chosen the
Japan Cup?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I've lost that race before, so in part, I just
want revenge... but it also just happened to be
the right time.

text_block_list.name: Entrevistador
text_block_list.text:
I see! Do you have any words for the fans who've
been eagerly awaiting your return?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You know... I don't think I'd like myself very
much if I just quit racing.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I—we run to become someone we love. So I hope you'll join me at this next race.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I'll be waiting.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wait, was she...
choice_data_list:
That certainly did feel directed at someone. |
Nombre=Yukino Bijin | Linea=Wait, was she... |
Anterior=...I'll be waiting. | Siguiente=Yeah, I
think so too...]

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I think so too...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I know what race I want t'join next.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Can I run in the Japan Cup? Pretty please? I absolutely have t'run there!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin's eyes reflect her staunch
determination. I can see she has no doubts—just
the straightforward desire to run alongside her
friend and idol.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks oodles!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You won't be wait'n long, City! I'm com'n for you!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: And so, we set our sights for the Japan Cup!
